description: Header file defining various neural network modules in the torch::nn namespace, including Identity, Linear, Flatten, Unflatten, and Bilinear, with their respective implementation classes, options, and module holders.

classes.name: IdentityImpl
classes.description: A placeholder identity operator that is argument-insensitive, with methods for reset, pretty_print, and forward.

classes.name: LinearImpl
classes.description: Applies a linear transformation with optional bias, with methods for reset, reset_parameters, pretty_print, and forward.

classes.name: FlattenImpl
classes.description: A placeholder for Flatten operator, with methods for reset, pretty_print, and forward.

classes.name: UnflattenImpl
classes.description: A placeholder for unflatten operator, with methods for reset, pretty_print, and forward.

classes.name: BilinearImpl
classes.description: Applies a bilinear transformation with optional bias, with methods for reset, reset_parameters, pretty_print, and forward.

methods.name: pretty_print
methods.description: Pretty prints the module into the provided stream.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the module's computation on the input tensor(s).

methods.name: reset_parameters
methods.description: Initializes or resets the module's parameters.
